version: GHCN-Daily Version 3; individual file identified by retrieval date and SHA-256

temperature.reason: JMA temperature homogeneity changes on 2014-12-02 when observations move from Otemachi to Kitanomaru Park. JMA says different homogeneity segments are not directly comparable; no daily adjustment is supplied, and neither segment alone passes the 1991–2020 coverage policy. Temperature remains on the regional grid; precipitation stays in one agency homogeneity segment.

precipitation.reason: The public KMA precipitation table contains blank cells without a verified dry-day code. Blanks are not converted to zero. A complete, quality-documented 1991–2020 precipitation series was not verified; precipitation remains on the regional grid.
